10月10日 11:00–11:45。演示免费；购书和市集购物另付。Heathe: October 10, 11–11:45 am. Free demonstration; books and market purchases cost extra. Heather Hardcastle demonstrates seasonal baking in front of the Ferry Building, followed by a cookbook signing. Samples do not constitute a free meal.

10月31日 11:00–13:00；演示11:00–11:45。活动与试吃免费: October 31, 11 am–1 pm; demonstration 11–11:45 am. Free activities and samples; market purchases cost extra. Taste fall fruit, collect recipes and vote for favorites at the orange tent. Sofía Jiménez of Tutuli demonstrates baking at the green Classroom tent at 11 am.
11月12日 15:00–19:00。逛市集；食材、餐饮和商品按摊位付费。Foo: November 12, 3–7 pm. Browse the market; produce, food and goods cost extra. Foodwise confirms November 12 as the last market of 2026, with a planned return in March 2027. Shop for seasonal produce; extra performances or free meals have not been announced.
